text: 极端天气频发，巨灾保险如何兜底 在巨灾发生频率增加且损失加重的情况下，仅依靠灾后财政救助已难以满足需求，建立更加完善的灾前风险分担体系和资金保障机制越发重要。
text_en: Extreme weather occurs frequently, how can catastrophe insurance provide a backstop? As the frequency of catastrophes increases and losses worsen, relying solely on post-disaster fiscal relief is no longer enough to meet demand, and establishing a more complete pre-disaster risk-sharing system and funding guarantee mechanism is becoming increasingly important.
